summary: Cred shares his experience trading through the March 2020 crash at a hedge fund and how the market has since recovered with strong institutional backing. He views the March crash as a generational bottom for Bitcoin, noting consistent Coinbase buying of 2-3k BTC daily and expects smaller drawdowns in this cycle due to stronger institutional holders. He has pivoted from pure Bitcoin trading to include NFT investments through Ego Capital, with a thesis that historical NFTs like CryptoPunks will retain value while copies approach zero. He warns that altcoins still have significant downside risk due to lack of institutional support.
